Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is bieng recorded for claim purposes. Can you please
state and spell your full name for the record?
A: Sure. It's the name on my policy, and I can spell it if you need me to.
Q: That's fine, we already have it on file. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection?
A: I was making a left turn at a signalized intersection in Pasadena, Texas. The light was green for me, or it had just
turned to a green arrow. I started into the turn when a vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front driver's
side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I glanced up and saw headlights, but I was focused on getting through the intersection. By the time I
registered it, it was already on me.
Q: How fast do you estimate you were traveling when you started the turn?
A: Very slow, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. I was basically creeping through the turn.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Where did you first feel pain or notice an injury?
A: My left wrist hit the steering wheel and the door frame when the airbag went off. I felt it right away, and it swelled
up quickly. I went to the emergency room later that day, and they told me it was fractured.
Q: Have you received any follow-up treatment since then?
A: I've had a cast put on, and I have an orthopedic appointment scheduled. I'm also having trouble gripping things for
work.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add before we finish?
A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get this resolved so I can get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. We'll be in touch with next steps. Have a good day.
A: You too. Thanks.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
